title: How Ellie Bamber Dealt With the Terror — and Sudden Empowerment — That Came With Playing Kate Moss
summary: The young British actress gets candid about working with the iconic supermodel, who serves as an executive producer on 'Moss & Freud,' a film about her relationship with the late painter Lucian Freud: "With Kate being as iconic as she is, this was going to be a totally different challenge."
